context: A coach gives a pre-game pep talk to a teen player
purpose: Teach: スタジアム/最強/青春/最大限/前進/レッド/強度/失う

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: リク、このスタジアムの空気をよく覚えとけ。今日が青春の本番だ。
lines.en: Riku, remember the air in this stadium well. Today is the real moment of your youth.
lines.style: Gruff veteran tone, short clipped sentences, paternal warmth beneath the bark.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: はい、コーチ。正直、相手は最強って言われてるんで、ちょっとビビってます。
lines.en: Yes, Coach. Honestly, they're called the strongest team, so I'm a bit nervous.
lines.style: Teen mumble, honest admission, slightly tense breathing between phrases.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: ビビっていい。だが、お前が持ってるものを最大限に出せ。それだけだ。
lines.en: Being nervous is fine. But put out everything you have at maximum. That's all.
lines.style: Firm command voice, deliberate pacing, eye contact implied through pauses.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 練習の強度、めっちゃ上げてきたんで、走り負けはしないつもりです。
lines.en: I cranked up the intensity of practice, so I don't plan to lose in running.
lines.style: Rising confidence, sporty casual register, slight chest-puffing pride.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: いいぞ。ただし、熱くなりすぎてレッドカードだけはもらうな。
lines.en: Good. But don't you dare get a red card from getting too hot-headed.
lines.style: Warning growl mixed with a half-smirk, jabbing finger energy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかってます。自信を失うことなく、冷静に戦います。
lines.en: I get it. Without losing my confidence, I'll fight calmly.
lines.style: Earnest nod-tone, clipped and determined, swallowing the nerves down.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 下がるな、迷うな。一歩でも前進しろ。それがうちのサッカーだ。
lines.en: Don't retreat, don't hesitate. Advance even one step. That's our soccer.
lines.style: Rhythmic three-beat command, rising volume, almost a chant by the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: はい!行ってきます、コーチ!
lines.en: Yes! I'm heading out there, Coach!
lines.style: Loud burst of adrenaline, voice cracking slightly with hype now.
